_comment: Robinhood Chain testnet (46630). Same PoolManager address and code hash as mainnet (checked 28 Oct 2026). WETH is the official L2 WETH from docs.robinhood.com/chain/protocol-contracts. Deployer and governor are a throwaway testnet wallet (.env.testnet, never committed). launchConfig uses tiny economics (graduation at about 0.0003 ETH) so the full lifecycle can be exercised with faucet ETH; mainnet economics live in deploy.robinhood-mainnet.json. version 2: BloomLaunch v2 (V3-style curves, launch fee + minimum dev buy).
